title: Tenma Tsukasa — Man Of Festivity〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: Happy New Year! Lion Dance Robot's New Year's Show!

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Nice work, everyone.
This seems like a good place to take a break.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm? A break? Already?
I can still keep going...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I kinda need a break.
We've been practicing for like three hours now.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What? Is that true?!
In that case, we should rest for a bit.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, and hydrate.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Then, let's all take a break☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! Nene, here's some water!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You don't sound like you need a break... But thanks.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Still, Tsukasa, you're so focused today.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah...! You got this look in your eye!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I thought the same thing!
Your eyes are all zingy! And you're going zoom-zoom-zoom when you move!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Zingy? Zoom-zoom-zoom?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hmm... I believe they're trying to say that you're moving like you mean it and that you look very serious while doing it.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! That's it, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Correctomundo♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Again, how does he always know...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No idea...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
But I agree with them.
You look like you're more motivated than usual, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh...
Is it that obvious?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The truth is, after we finished doing our little tour, I've been wanting to grow more as an actor!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Our escapade allowed us to perform in all sorts of different places with a wide variety of people.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Remember how each show went a bit differently depending on who ended up helping us?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! When Honami and her friends sang for us at the beach, we changed our dance routine a little☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. And MORE MORE JUMP! did an amazing job of interacting with the audience when we performed on top of that mountain.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Exactly! The same goes for when Shiraishi and her partner helped us, as well as Yoisaki!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We gained and learned much because we performed alongside different people compared to normal in places we don't usually go.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I felt the same thing when we performed with Asahi and his troupe the other day. So, I believe new encounters can lead to new discoveries!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And there are plenty of people out there that we have yet to meet!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So, that means...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The more new people you meet, the more new things you stand to learn or gain, which may lead to further growth, yes?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What do you all say?! How exciting would it be to make such discoveries?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I'm getting excited just at the thought of that☆

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Me too! Me too!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I understand how you feel, Tsukasa, but accomplishing that really won't be easy...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. But it's something we'd expect you to say.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I agree.
The power of positivity makes dreams come true.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hahaha! That is exactly my point!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Let us take what we learned from the shows we just did and propel ourselves forward this year!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Bear witness as I, Tsukasa Tenma, future star... No, wait...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Bear witness as I, Tsukasa Tenma, future superstar, accomplish feats of true greatness!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hah hah hah hah!

rows.Speaker: Emu & Miku
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Now that he's feeling better, I'll be looking forward to what the future has in store for us.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, he seems like he's back to normal.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe.
